_doc: Milestone perks (docs/PLAYER_SYSTEMS.md §2): unlocked the first time a skill reaches its milestone, kept after a death lowers the skill

perks.name: Steady edge
perks.description: Light swings with a blade cost less stamina.

perks.name: Riposte
perks.description: A parry with a blade opens the attacker to a fast cut.

perks.name: Disarm
perks.description: A perfect parry can knock the weapon from a foe's hand.

perks.name: Masterstroke
perks.description: Heavy cuts never glance off armour.

perks.name: Heavy hand
perks.description: Blunt hits drain more poise.

perks.name: Bell ringer
perks.description: A heavy blow to the head staggers through a block.

perks.name: Shield breaker
perks.description: Blunt weapons wear down shields and armour faster.

perks.name: Felling blow
perks.description: A full heavy swing knocks a grown man down.

perks.name: Steady draw
perks.description: Less sway while holding a drawn bow.

perks.name: Quick nock
perks.description: Faster draw between shots.

perks.name: Long shot
perks.description: Arrows keep their force at long range.

perks.name: Ranger's eye
perks.description: Wind barely moves your arrows.

perks.name: Braced
perks.description: Blocking costs less stamina.

perks.name: Wide parry
perks.description: The parry window is longer.

perks.name: Unshaken
perks.description: Poise recovers faster after a block.

perks.name: Wall
perks.description: A block with a shield turns aside even a heavy blow.

perks.name: Second wind
perks.description: Stamina starts to return sooner after spending it.

perks.name: Sure-footed
perks.description: Climbing and swimming cost less stamina.

perks.name: Long legs
perks.description: Sprinting costs less stamina.

perks.name: Tireless
perks.description: Stamina returns twice as fast.

perks.name: Soft step
perks.description: Walking makes less noise.

perks.name: Light fingers
perks.description: Simple locks open faster and more quietly.

perks.name: One with the dark
perks.description: In shadow, onlookers see you only up close.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.description: Standing still in shadow, you are not seen at all.

perks.name: True weld
perks.description: Repairs restore more durability.

perks.name: Maker's mark
perks.description: Items you forge carry your mark; anyone who sees the mark knows who made them.

perks.name: Fine temper
perks.description: Forged steel comes out a grade finer.

perks.name: Master smith
perks.description: You can re-forge a broken blade better than it was.

perks.name: Clean fell
perks.description: Felling yields more timber.

perks.name: True grain
perks.description: Bows and hafts you make are stronger.

perks.name: Fletcher
perks.description: Each batch of arrows yields more.

perks.name: Master joiner
perks.description: What you build in wood lasts a lifetime.

perks.name: Know a root by its leaf
perks.description: Herbs show what they are good for before you cook them.

perks.name: Steady hand
perks.description: Remedies come out stronger.

perks.name: No waste
perks.description: Gathering a plant leaves the root to grow back faster.

perks.name: Healer's art
perks.description: Dubious food is rare; most mixtures do some good.

perks.name: Good swing
perks.description: Breaking stone costs less stamina.

perks.name: Rich seam
perks.description: Ore yields more.

perks.name: Read the stone
perks.description: You can tell where ore runs before you strike.

perks.name: Deep hand
perks.description: Picks wear out half as fast.

perks.name: Fair dealer
perks.description: Prices tilt a little your way.

perks.name: Calming word
perks.description: Talk ends a fight more often.

perks.name: Crowd reader
perks.description: You can speak to a gathering crowd and be heard.

perks.name: Silver tongue
perks.description: Hardened bargainers meet you halfway.

perks.name: Keen eye
perks.description: More clues show when you examine things.

perks.name: Old hands
perks.description: You can read old script and ledger cyphers.

perks.name: Scholar
perks.description: Puzzles offer a hint when you are stuck.

perks.name: Archivist
perks.description: You remember every page you have read.
